description:
Peter (Jason Segel) gathers the courage to ask Rachel (Mila Kunis) out on a date, leading to a romantic night on the beach that is abruptly crashed by her ex. The pair head to a bar where Rachel surprises Peter by volunteering him to perform his Dracula-themed musical in front of everyone.
